claim: AUDIT §2 item 2: PAPER 'suggests a concrete instance of Selberg's framework'; eigenvalues<->Riemann zeros 'conjectured'; GUE/Poisson 'impossible at 30'

a_level_stats.note: GOE is the correct ensemble for this real symmetric operator; Universals/spectral_analysis.py level_spacing_stats tested GUE (beta=2) instead
a_level_stats.verdict: POISSON (ratio z(GOE)=-5.50 excludes GOE 0.5307; KS p=0.0034 vs GOE Wigner, p=0.7436 vs Poisson)

b_zeros.note_old: the old min-dist/within-0.5 were computed against only the 15 zeros in RIEMANN_ZEROS (docstrings claimed 100) and are vacuous: the disk t-range never reaches the first zero
b_zeros.verdict: NOT TESTABLE AT 100 MODES - the disk t-range [2.38, 7.03] never reaches the first zero t1=14.13 (gap 7.10), so 'min dist 7.10, 0 within 0.5' is a scale mismatch, not a measured absence. And the mismatch is structural: the capped disk's measured Weyl density is 2.35 levels per unit E vs the zeros' 0.00456 per unit E at t1 - a factor 516 - so no number of disk modes can reproduce the zeros' spectrum (reaching t1 alone needs ~471 modes, reaching t15 needs ~9978).

c_form_factor.note: matched-bootstrap null (resample the length set with replacement, preserving the ell-distribution); the old permutation null was degenerate (constant mean) and the old 18.8 was floating-point noise
c_form_factor.verdict: NO TRACE-FORMULA SIGNATURE: the Mersenne lengths' mean |C| sits at the 52th percentile of matched random length-sets (null), their local percentiles average 49.4 (50 = chance), and 51/173 exceed the 70% local mark (~52 expected by chance). The old 'mean pct 18.8 / max pct 100.0 / 0 strong' statistics were invalid (degenerate permutation null + the ln(32/29)=0.098 edge artifact).
